label: early original-phase run of tokens from {r,g,t,j,y,s,3,...}
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99.9% of activation mass). It never fires at t=0, the delimiter, or in the copy phase (only 12 copy-phase activations). It peaks at t=2-3 and fades by t=8. It fires when the current input comes from a token group, strongest for r (8x lift), then g, t, j (~5x), then y, u, s, p, 3, i, AND the one or two inputs before it also come from a similar group (t, j, g, y, r, s, 3). It acts like an accumulator that builds up over a short early run of these tokens. The largest activations are on r right after another group token at t=2 (e.g. y t r, r j r, y j r). Repeated tokens raise the firing rate a bit (in_count 3-4 gives 2.3-2.8x lift). It almost never fires on b or k, or after tokens outside the group. Recall from in_tok in the group alone is about 99%, but precision is only 7%. The recorded predicate (group token, preceded by a group token, t<=5, and either the token is r or the input two steps back is also in the group) reaches dev F1 0.52 and mass recall 0.71. The remaining errors come from graded membership in the group and from decay with position, which a boolean predicate does not capture.
